subject: Two things - accident claim and a new issue
body:
Hi Amelia,

Two things in one email, sorry!

1) On the accident claim (SEN/1029/003/AB) - any update from Insureco yet?

2) Separately, my elderly mother Margaret Whitfield has a dispute with her landlord about a deposit and mould in the flat. She's not with your firm yet but asked me to ask if you take on housing cases too. Her address is 22 Birch Grove, Slough SL1 3QW if that's useful.

Thanks,
James
